method: Every MP3 decoded at 96kHz for true peak, clipping, seam energy and active RMS. Watched sentence onsets also have a limit on sustained high-frequency noise before voicing. Prompt-free English ASR excludes only post-sentence recall gaps. Failed short units are also checked as repeated audio without a text prompt; raw transcripts retained privately. Homophones explicitly normalized. Neither acoustic gates nor ASR prove subjective naturalness.
